rationale: The first reply wrongly says wet plastics are 'not normal' and lists a heating element, thermostat and drain pump fault under 'When to Call Service', which is an unsupported claim. It also uses US-style details (120°F, garbage disposal) that don't suit a UK home. After the customer's details, the second reply correctly identifies the empty rinse aid, Eco 50 and immediate unloading as causes, explains why plastics stay wet, and suggests sensible fixes. It suggests the door-closed wait and a different programme, and shows how to check for extra dry, though some of the Zeolith and level 6 detail is speculative. No part is recommended and no engineer is needed, which fits the case.
